subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select "No substitution."

"The company has __**done away for**__ unnecessary paperwork by going completely digital."
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb "**done away with**" is the correct form to indicate the removal or elimination of something.
 
• In the given sentence, the context refers to eliminating unnecessary paperwork, so "**done away with**" is the appropriate replacement.
